author: Contributor 86
about: The MySQL 8.0 manual's examples (spec/doc-examples.json: every example of each vendored function section, and of the small pages whole), each sent through Execute as @planetscale/database sends it, with a live admin password made on PlanetScale's dashboard (its Connect page), as the life makes one, and only the setup its precondition needs. The management API's one served operation, create_backup, replays its reference page's example with a service token the settings page made and gave write_backups. Credentials are captured as opaque values: https://planetscale.com/docs/vitess/connecting/connection-strings documents a unique username and password pair, and https://planetscale.com/docs/vitess/tutorials/planetscale-serverless-driver names <PS_USERNAME> without a hexadecimal format or fixed length.
